Subject: Lodging concierge splits and bedroom matrix

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for taking our RFP call yesterday. We’re finalizing hotel logistics for a two-day enterprise workshop (Redwood execs + 40 external attendees) the week of Oct 12–13. A couple of asks to confirm so we can finalize the rooming matrix: 

- Block size: hold 50 rooms night of Oct 11–13 with an attrition allowance of 10%.
- Rate harmonization: can we keep King and Double rates within $15 of each other (same corporate rate code)?
- Quiet floors / executive adjacency: reserve a 6–8 room contiguous block on a higher floor for leadership (prefer rooms ending in 01–08).
- Early check-in / late checkout: guaranteed early check-in for 8 execs, and late checkout for 10 attendees.
- Accessibility & dietary lifts: list of 3 attendees require roll-in shower / hypoallergenic bedding.
- Billing: preference is master bill for rooms + incidental cards for incidentals, but procurement may ask to split per-dept — confirm options.
- Shuttle: one round-trip shuttle on Oct 12 morning (airport–hotel) and return Oct 13 evening.

Attached is a draft rooming template (master_rooming_sheet.csv) that we'll populate once rates and the deposit schedule are confirmed. Can you return a short option matrix (rates/fee schedule/deposit) by end of day Tuesday (Aug 25)?

Appreciate it —

Chloe Martin
Events Program Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: master_rooming_sheet.csv]

From: Hannah Cole <hannah.cole@atlashospitality.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Lodging concierge splits and bedroom matrix

Hi Chloe —

Great to hear from you. We can support the request; below are two viable options we recommend based on occupancy in October.

Option A — Preferred Block
- 50 rooms held (Oct 11–13) with 10% attrition allowance
- King (K) / Double (D) parity within $10 — corporate code REDW-2026
- 6 contiguous rooms reserved on the 7th floor for leadership (rooms 701–706)
- Early check-in for 8 rooms guaranteed (charge waived)
- Shuttle: $450 flat for round-trip (50 seats)
- Deposit: 25% to confirm hold; refundable up to 45 days out

Option B — Lower Rate, Flexible Block
- 50 rooms held, 5% attrition
- King/Double gap up to $20, but includes a complimentary upgrade for 10 rooms at arrival
- Executive adjacency on request (nearby rooms on 6th floor)
- Shuttle: $375 flat
- Deposit: 15% non-refundable after 30 days

We can add specific accessibility accommodations and dietary meal planning in the contract appendix. Attached is a draft group contract that captures both options — please indicate your preferred option and any contract language you need on billing (master bill vs split).

Hannah Cole
Sr. Sales Manager — Group Events
Atlas Hospitality Group
[Attachment: Group_Contract_Attachment.pdf]

Thanks everyone — quick decisions to keep timeline tight: 

- We’ll move forward with Option B (lower rate + 10 complimentary upgrades) provided Hannah can update contract language to: deposit 10% refundable up to 30 days out and list the 10 guaranteed arrival upgrades.
- Billing: master bill to Redwood PO (net-30). Finance will complete onboarding paperwork after contract final.
- Executive block: please reserve rooms 601–608 (6 contiguous rooms) for leadership, hypoallergenic bedding noted.
- Shuttle: confirm the $375 flat rate and include in master bill.

Miles — can Paladino Travel start the hold and provisional bookings once Hannah sends the updated contract/DocuSign link? We’ll push final names and arrival times by Aug 28. I’ve uploaded the current rooming sheet here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aBcDeFGh2-example (see tab: "Prelim names").
